$comment: Minimum hand-written codec counts of the families taking part in the MK2 migration, keyed by the family's current home. A relocated port keeps its module at src/<codec>/codec.js and is counted; a codec authored for MK3 lives at src/formats/<codec>/codec.js and is not, because it was never an MK2 port to lose. Block 11 slice 11B follows that split inside common/documents: ODT, ODS and ODP moved in as ports, ODG was authored here. Block 12 slice 12-2 moved RTF the same way and shows the other half of the mechanic: the staging hand-port reverted to its generated port-pending stub, so mk2/uncommon-documents lost a ported codec while common/documents gained the same one, and the total never moved. Relocating a family renames its key and keeps its count; it never retires the guarantee. Increment in the same change that ports a codec; ports:check rejects regressions, stale counts, and a family that disappears together with its entry.
